items.q: What kind of help does speech therapist Kinga Krajs provide?
items.a: Kinga Krajs is a speech and language therapist. Based on medical knowledge and experience, she provides: a speech therapy consultation (first visit) with a therapy plan and recommendations for the parent (60 min), and speech therapy sessions (follow-up visits, 30 or 45 min).

items.q: How much does a visit cost?
items.a: The speech therapy consultation (first visit) with a therapy plan and recommendations costs PLN 150 and lasts 60 minutes. A follow-up therapy visit costs PLN 80 (30 min) or PLN 120 (45 min).

items.q: Where and when does she see patients?
items.a: The practice is located at Biernota 11, 44-230 Czerwionka-Leszczyny, Poland. Appointments are held on Tuesdays and Thursdays, 7:30 am–7:00 pm.

items.q: In which languages does she provide consultations?
What areas does she specialise in?
items.a: Kinga Krajs specialises in working with Asperger syndrome, swallowing disorders, speech disorders, speech exercises and autism.

I am an educator and a speech therapist. I completed a master's degree in early childhood and preschool education, as well as postgraduate studies in speech therapy. I am currently expanding my knowledge through postgraduate studies in autism. I have completed numerous trainings and internships.

items.q: How do I book a visit?
items.a: Call +48 518 542 193, write using the contact form on this page, or use the practice's profile on Medfile.
